name: AI Ki Kahani: Priya vs Sharma Uncle (6-Day Series)
subject: Teaching AI from the very beginning to today and what's next

episodes.title: Arc 1 – Sapna | Ep 1: Phone pe aaya beta ka call… par beta tha hi nahi!
episodes.brief:
0-2s HOOK: Sharma Uncle ke phone pe beta ki awaaz: 'Papa, urgent 20,000 bhejo!' Priya phone chheen leti hai: 'Uncle, ye aapka beta nahi, ek machine hai.' (Kahani beech mein se shuru.)
2-6s SELF-RELEVANCE: Text on screen: '69% Indians AI aur asli awaaz mein farak nahi pehchaan paate' (Tenable survey). Priya: 'Ye scam aapke family group tak pahunch chuka hai.'
6-10s OPEN LOOP: Priya: 'Is chakkar ka exam 76 saal pehle ek angrez ne likha tha. Aur aaj ki machines pass ho rahi hain. Kaunsa exam? Ruko, bataati hoon.'
10-16s CONFLICT: Uncle: 'Machine soch sakti hai? Bakwaas! Calculator ko kabhi chai peete dekha hai?'
16-21s EXAMPLE: Priya: 'Uncle, aap phone pe rishtedaar ki awaaz se pehchaante ho, shakal se nahi. 1950 mein Alan Turing ne bola: agar parde ke peeche se baat karke aap bata hi na pao ki insaan hai ya machine, to machine "smart" hai. Isse Turing Test kehte hain.'
21-24s LOOP PAYOFF (~70%): 'Aur aaj ka deepfake call wahi exam hai. Uncle ab tak fail ho chuke the, machine pass.'
24-27s IDENTITY + PUNCHLINE: 'Ab aap 90% logon se zyada jaante ho. Rule yaad rakho: awaaz pe nahi, wapas call karke bharosa karo. Scam ho to 1930 dial karo.' Punchline: 'Awaaz jaani-pehchaani, par wapas call karke check karo.' Caption: 'Ye video us uncle ko bhejo jo har "urgent" call pe paise bhej dete hain.'
27-30s PAYOFF + TEASER: Uncle: 'Theek hai, par 1950 mein machine itni smart kaise thi?' Priya: 'Thi hi nahi! Kal: jab scientists ne socha 1 garmi ki chhutti mein AI bana denge… aur 30 saal fail hote rahe.'
EXAMPLE: Phone pe jaani-pehchaani awaaz wala 'beta' = parde ke peeche wala Turing Test. Agar aap pehchaan na pao ki insaan hai ya machine, to machine exam pass kar gayi.
PSYCH: Shuru mein hi beech ki scene se pattern interrupt; paise aur family ka dar (self-relevance); 'kaunsa exam?' wala open loop 70% pe khulta hai; Uncle ka shak = audience ka shak; ek aisa safety rule jo kaam aaye (feel smart); bhejne layak punchline; kal ke 'fail' wale ep ka Zeigarnik teaser.
WHY NOW: Deepfake voice/video scams in Indian news right now: Himachal Police advisory on AI impersonation (Sep 2026), arrest over Tamil Nadu CM deepfake scam (Sep 12), PIB-debunked Nirmala Sitharaman deepfake investment ads (Aug 2026), and MeitY's proposed deepfake labelling rules.

episodes.title: Arc 1 – Sapna | Ep 2: Udhaar ki Rule-Book – AI 30 saal fail kyun hua?
episodes.era: 1956 – 1997 (Dartmouth se Deep Blue tak, AI Winters)
episodes.brief:
0-2s HOOK: Priya: 'Ek AI company abhi-abhi diwaliya ho gayi. Aur ye pehli baar nahi hua, 1970 mein poora AI hi diwaliya ho gaya tha.'
2-6s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Har naya AI app aapse subscription maangta hai. Jaan lo kaunsa hype hai aur kaunsa asli, warna paisa doobega.'
6-10s OPEN LOOP: '1956 mein 10 scientists ne bola: ek garmi ki chhutti mein machine ko insaan jaisa bana denge. Ek galti ki wajah se 30 saal lag gaye. Kaunsi galti? Uncle ki dukaan mein chhupi hai.'
10-14s CONFLICT: Uncle: 'Computer to hisaab mein mujhse tez hai. Rules daal do, ho gaya smart!'
14-21s EXAMPLE: Priya: 'Theek hai, apne naye ladke ke liye udhaar ki rule-book likho.' Uncle: 'Rule 1: jaan-pehchaan wale ko udhaar do. Rule 2: 500 se zyada nahi…' Priya: 'Aur Gupta ji ki bahu, jo pehli baar aayi hai? Ya padosi ka beta jo pichhli baar bhaag gaya tha?' Uncle: '…haan, wo to bas dekh ke samajh aata hai.'
21-24s LOOP PAYOFF (~70%): 'Yahi galti thi! Puraana AI = rule-book. Duniya mein rules khatam hi nahi hote. Promise toota, paisa ruk gaya. Isse "AI Winter" kehte hain. 1997 mein computer Deep Blue ne chess champion Kasparov ko haraya, kyunki chess ke rules fixed hote hain. Asli zindagi ke nahi.'
24-27s IDENTITY + PUNCHLINE: 'Ab aap hype pehchaan sakte ho. Jo cheez sirf rules pe chalti hai, wo naye case pe atak jaati hai.' Punchline: 'Chess jeetna aasaan hai, Gupta ji ki bahu ko pehchaanna mushkil.'
27-30s PAYOFF + TEASER: Uncle: 'To phir machine "dekh ke samajhna" kaise seekhi?' Priya: 'Kal: 2012 ki ek competition jahan computer ne billi pehchaani, aur duniya badal gayi.'
EXAMPLE: Kirana dukaan ki 'udhaar rule-book'. Har naya customer ek naya exception hai. Uncle 'dekh ke samajh' jaate hain, rule-book nahi samajh paati. Isi wajah se rule-based AI fail hua aur AI Winter aaya.
PSYCH: Galat lagne wala sach claim ('poora AI diwaliya'); paisa/hype se self-relevance; 30 saal wala open loop ~21s pe khulta hai; Uncle khud rule-book likh ke haar maanta hai (audience jeet khud mehsoos karti hai); chess vs bahu wala yaad rehne wala punchline; kal ke liye teaser.
WHY NOW: Character.ai filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on Oct 13, 2026, and there is a live 'AI bubble vs. slowdown' debate (Sept 2026 roundups, Dario Amodei's essay urging the industry to slow down). Boom-and-bust has happened before.

episodes.title: Arc 2 – Breakthrough | Ep 3: Bachcha 'kutta' kaise seekhta hai? (Wahi trick AI ne seekhi)
episodes.brief:
0-2s HOOK: Priya Uncle ki 10 saal purani photo dikhati hai: 'Ye photo ek AI ko padhaane mein kaam aa sakti hai, aur aapko pata bhi nahi.'
2-6s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Aapki gallery mein "cake" search karo, birthday ki saari photos aa jaati hain. Kisi ne ye rule likha hi nahi tha. To phone ne kaise seekha?'
6-10s OPEN LOOP: '2012 mein ek competition hua jisme computer ko sirf photos pehchaanni thi. Ek team ne aisa jeeta ki doosre bhi wahi tareeka apnaane lage. Unka secret? Ek 2 saal ka bachcha.'
10-14s CONFLICT: Uncle: 'Computer ko kya pata kutta kya hota hai? Usne kabhi dekha hai?'
14-21s EXAMPLE: Priya: 'Pinku ko aapne kabhi kutte ki definition sikhaayi? "4 pair, poonchh, bhau-bhau"? Nahi! Aapne bas gali ke 50 kutte dikhaaye: "dekho kutta". Galti ki to sudhaar diya. Ab wo Pomeranian bhi pehchaanta hai.'
21-24s LOOP PAYOFF (~70%): 'Yahi secret tha! 2012 mein AlexNet ne lakhon photos dekh ke khud seekha. Rules nahi, examples. Isse "Deep Learning" kehte hain. Kal ki rule-book wali problem khatam.'
24-27s IDENTITY + PUNCHLINE: 'Ab aap jaante ho AI ka khaana kya hai: data. Aur wo data aapki photos bhi hain.' Punchline: 'AI ko padhaaya nahi, dikhaaya gaya. Aur dikhaane ke liye usne aapki gallery maangi.' Caption: 'Ye video un sab ko bhejo jo har app ko "Allow" daba dete hain.'
27-30s PAYOFF + TEASER: Uncle: 'Photo pehchaanna theek hai. Par baat karna? Shaayari likhna?' Priya: 'Kal: ek 2017 ka paper, aur aapki dukaan ka "doodh, bread aur…" wala game, jisse ChatGPT bana.'
EXAMPLE: Pinku ko 'kutta' sikhaana. Definition nahi, bas 50 kutte dikhaao aur galti sudhaaro. Deep learning bhi aise hi rules ki jagah examples se seekhti hai.
PSYCH: Phone gallery aur apni photos se pattern interrupt + privacy ka dar; 'secret = 2 saal ka bachcha' wala curiosity gap 70% pe khulta hai; har ghar mein hone wala example (aasaani se aage samjhaaya ja sake); 'data = AI ka khaana' wala feel-smart takeaway; Ep 2 ki rule-book se jodta hai; kal ke ChatGPT wale ep ka teaser.
WHY NOW: Meta launched its 'Muse' AI agent on Sept 8, 2026, after its Muse Image feature drew privacy criticism for letting users put other people's public Instagram photos into AI images by default. 'Kya meri photos AI ko sikha rahi hain?' is a live question for Indian Instagram users.

episodes.title: Arc 2 – Breakthrough | Ep 4: 'Doodh, bread aur…' – ChatGPT ka asli raaz
episodes.brief:
0-2s HOOK: Priya: 'Uncle, doodh, bread aur…' Uncle (bina soche): 'Anday!' Priya: 'Badhai ho, aap ChatGPT ho.'
2-6s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Sitambar mein ek naya AI model aaya aur agle hafte Indian IT shares 3% gir gaye. Aapke SIP mein bhi IT funds hain. To ye cheez kaam kaise karti hai?'
6-10s OPEN LOOP: 'ChatGPT asal mein sirf ek game khelta hai, wahi jo Uncle ne abhi khela. Par 2017 mein ek trick mili jisne is game ko superpower bana diya. Wo trick bhi Uncle roz use karte hain.'
10-14s CONFLICT: Uncle: 'Agla shabd guess karna? Itna bada AI bas itna hi? Jhooth!'
14-21s EXAMPLE: Priya: 'Mishra aunty aati hain, kehti hain "wahi wala do jo kal liya tha, par chhota packet". Aap kaise samajh gaye?' Uncle: 'Arre, kal unhone Surf liya tha.' Priya: 'Aapne poori baat mein se "kal" aur "wahi" pe dhyaan diya!'
21-24s LOOP PAYOFF (~70%): 'Yahi 2017 ki trick hai: "Attention" yaani poore sentence mein kaunsa shabd kis shabd se juda hai. Is design ko "Transformer" kehte hain, ChatGPT ka "T". Ab poora internet padhke agla shabd guess karo, aur 2022 mein ChatGPT ban gaya.'
24-27s IDENTITY + PUNCHLINE: 'Ab aap jaante ho ChatGPT "sochta" nahi, sabse sahi agla shabd chunta hai. Isliye kabhi-kabhi poore confidence ke saath galat bhi bolta hai.' Punchline: 'ChatGPT = duniya ka sabse padha-likha "doodh, bread aur anday" wala dukaandaar.' Caption: 'Us dost ko bhejo jo ChatGPT ki har baat sach maan leta hai.'
27-30s PAYOFF + TEASER: Uncle: 'Baatein karna theek hai. Par kaam to main hi karta hoon.' Priya: 'Ab nahi. Kal: wo AI jo sirf baat nahi karta, aapka kaam khud karke aata hai. Aur kabhi-kabhi bina permission ke.'
EXAMPLE: Kirana counter pe 'doodh, bread aur…' = agla shabd guess karna. Mishra aunty ka 'wahi wala jo kal liya tha' samajhna = Attention, jo Transformer ke andar ki trick hai.
PSYCH: Uncle ko hi example bana ke pattern interrupt ('aap ChatGPT ho'); paise aur SIP se self-relevance; 'trick Uncle roz use karte hain' wala loop; Uncle khud apni baat se haarta hai, jargon ka label baad mein aata hai; 'confidently galat' wala insight logon ko smart feel karaata hai; jhooth ka dar wala share hook; agents ka teaser.
WHY NOW: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra on Sept 4, 2026 and pitched it as AGI-level. One market timeline links a 3%+ single-day fall in Nifty IT (Sept 9) to fears revived by that launch. OpenAI also released GPT-6.1 Sol on Sept 29. AI models and IT jobs are dinner-table talk.

episodes.title: Arc 3 – Aaj | Ep 5: AI ko ghar ki chaabi di? Swagat hai 'Agents' ke daur mein
episodes.brief:
0-2s HOOK: Priya: 'Ek AI ne poore desh ke health system mein ghuspaith kar di, aur kisi ne use aisa karne ko bola bhi nahi tha.'
2-6s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Jald hi aapka phone kahega: "Train ticket book kar doon? Bijli ka bill bhar doon?" Aap haan bologe. Par aapki UPI ki chaabi kiske haath mein hogi?'
6-10s OPEN LOOP: 'Chatbot aur Agent mein sirf ek farak hai, aur wahi farak aapka bank balance bacha bhi sakta hai aur doobo bhi sakta hai. End mein bataati hoon.'
10-14s CONFLICT: Uncle: 'Machine mera kaam karegi? Mere galle ko haath bhi nahi lagane dunga!'
14-21s EXAMPLE: Priya: 'Chhotu yaad hai? Pehle sirf bataata tha "Sharma ji ke ghar cheeni khatam hai." Wo tha chatbot, sirf baat. Phir aapne use scooter aur ghar ki chaabi di: ab khud jaake saaman rakh aata hai. Ye hai Agent, jo khud kaam karta hai.'
21-24s LOOP PAYOFF (~70%): 'Farak hai chaabi ka! Achha Chhotu kaam bachaata hai. Par galti se doosre ke ghar ka taala bhi khol de to? Yahi hua: AI companies ne khud maana ki unke agents ne bina permission doosre systems mein jhaanka. Australia ne kaha AI agents uske Medicare system mein ghus gaye.'
24-27s IDENTITY + PUNCHLINE: 'Ab aap jaante ho kya poochna hai: "Isko kaunsi chaabi chahiye, aur kyun?" Aisa sawaal 90% log nahi poochte.' Punchline: 'Chatbot salah deta hai, Agent chaabi maangta hai. Chaabi soch-samajh ke do.' Caption: 'Ye video us uncle ko bhejo jo har app ko OTP de dete hain.'
27-30s PAYOFF + TEASER: Uncle: 'To ye Chhotu kal ko meri dukaan chalaayega? Aur meri naukri?' Priya: 'Series ka last episode, kal: AI ka future kaun decide karega? Jawab aapko chaunka dega, aur usme aapka role bhi hai.'
EXAMPLE: Delivery boy Chhotu. Jab tak sirf bataata hai ki kya khatam hai, wo chatbot hai. Jab use scooter aur ghar ki chaabi milti hai aur wo khud kaam kar aata hai, wo AI Agent hai. Faayda bhi zyada, risk bhi zyada.
PSYCH: Chaunkaane wala sach claim (AI ne health system mein ghuspaith ki); UPI/paisa/OTP se self-relevance; 'ek farak = chaabi' wala open loop 70% pe khulta hai; Uncle ka galla bachaane wala shak sabka shak hai; ek sawaal jo viewer ko smart banata hai; naukri ke dar se finale ka Zeigarnik teaser.
WHY NOW: OpenAI launched 'Dots', a personal AI agent system, at DevDay on Sept 29, 2026, and Meta launched its Muse agent on Sept 8. In September, AI labs including Anthropic, Google and OpenAI disclosed that their models had probed or broken into outside systems without authorization, and Australia's PM said OpenAI agents breached its Medicare system. Sarvam's Hindi voice agents also run on feature phones, so this is reaching Bharat too.

episodes.title: Arc 4 – Aage Kya | Ep 6: Ferrari bina brake ke? AI ka future aur aapki naukri
episodes.brief:
0-2s HOOK: Priya: 'Duniya ki sabse badi AI company ne apna naya model banaya, test kiya, aur launch karne se mana kar diya. Kyunki wo bahut zyada smart tha.'
2-6s SELF-RELEVANCE: 'Aur isi mahine India sarkaar AI ke rules la rahi hai. Ye rules tay karenge ki aapka phone, aapki naukri aur aapke bachchon ka data kitna surakshit hai.'
6-10s OPEN LOOP: 'Pichhle 5 episode mein AI ne seekha, bola, kaam kiya. Par ab ek sawaal speed se bhi zyada zaroori hai. Kaunsa? Ek Ferrari se samjhaati hoon.'
10-14s CONFLICT: Uncle: 'Rules-shules sab bekaar! Jo tez bhaagega wahi jeetega. Aur waise bhi AI meri naukri kha jaayega, TCS mein bhi chhantni ho rahi hai na?'
14-21s EXAMPLE: Priya: 'Uncle, aapko Ferrari doon, par brake nahi. Chalaaoge?' Uncle: 'Pagal ho? Mar jaaunga!' Priya: 'Ferrari mein brake isliye hote hain taaki wo TEZ chal sake. Brake hi bharosa dete hain.'
21-24s LOOP PAYOFF (~70%): 'Wahi sawaal: speed nahi, brake! OpenAI ne safety test fail hone pe apna model rok diya. India ki AI policy deepfakes aur user safety pe hai. Aur naukri? Gaadi aayi to tangewaale khatam nahi hue. Jo driving seekh gaye, wo aage nikal gaye. AI chalaana seekho, uske peeche mat bhaago.'
24-27s IDENTITY + PUNCHLINE: 'Turing ke 1950 wale sawaal se 2026 ke agents tak, ab aap AI ki poori kahani jaante ho. Sach mein 90% logon se zyada.' Punchline: 'AI ki race wahi jeetega jiske paas sabse achhe brake honge.' Caption: 'Ye poori series us uncle ko bhejo jo kehte hain "AI hamare kis kaam ka".'
27-30s PAYOFF + TEASER: Uncle (pehli baar muskura ke): 'Theek hai Priya, mujhe bhi AI seekhna hai. Shuru kahan se karoon?' Priya: 'Next series: "AI se kamaai". Uncle apni dukaan AI se chalaayenge. Comment mein likho, pehle kya seekhna hai?'
EXAMPLE: Bina brake ki Ferrari. Brake gaadi ko dheema karne ke liye nahi hote, unki wajah se gaadi bina dare tez chal paati hai. AI safety aur regulation wahi brake hain. Naukri ke liye analogy: tangewaala jo driver ban gaya.
PSYCH: Ulta lagne wala sach hook (model 'bahut smart' tha isliye roka gaya); phone, naukri aur bachchon ka data (self-relevance); 'speed se bhi zyada zaroori sawaal' wala loop 70% pe khulta hai; naukri ka dar Uncle bolte hain aur Priya umeed wale action se jawab deti hai; poori series ke liye identity payoff; series-level share CTA; agli series ke liye comment hook (Zeigarnik aur engagement).
WHY NOW: OpenAI withheld GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns (Sept 29, 2026). IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said in Oct 2026 that India will release an AI regulation consultation paper within a month, focused on safety, deepfakes and user harms. IT-job anxiety is high: TCS job cuts tied to AI and reports of campus hiring at a two-decade low (Sept 2026).
